messages:
ana: hitting an annoying behavior in the python async client on non-json error responses. when server returns 400 with text/html the client calls response.json() and bubbles up a JSONDecodeError, so users lose status_code + headers. repro attached.

ana: minimal async repro:```py
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def main():
    async with AsyncClient(api_key=...) as c:
        try:
            await c.generate('hi')
        except Exception as e:
            print(type(e), e)
            # no .status_code / .raw_body available
```

ana: failing response (faked):
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
X-Request-Id: req_ABC123

<html>bad input</html>

josh: which release? sync vs async?

ana: 0.9.2 async client. quick hack shows requests.Response.json() being invoked and raising ValueError before we wrap. stack:```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "test_async.py", line 20, in <module>
    await client.generate('hi')
  File ".../redwood/sdk/async_client.py", line 142, in request
    body = resp.json()
  File ".../site-packages/requests/models.py", line 900, in json
    return complexjson.loads(self.text)
ValueError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
```

maria: yikes. SDK should never leak a raw JSONDecodeError as the top-level exception. Proposed shape: ApiError(Exception) with attrs: status_code: int, headers: Dict[str, str], raw_body: str, parsed: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], request_id: Optional[str]. Also ensure both sync and async clients raise the same ApiError.

josh: minimal fix idea: wrap the parse call and always raise ApiError on non-2xx, attaching resp.text and headers. Example:```py
try:
    parsed = resp.json()
except Exception:
    parsed = None
if resp.status_code >= 400:
    err = ApiError('HTTP error')
    err.status_code = resp.status_code
    err.headers = resp.headers
    err.raw_body = resp.text
    err.parsed = parsed
    raise err
```

ana: also please add a .request_id property helper that looks up common header names (x-request-id, x-rw-request-id) so apps can log it easily. typing: add these attrs into __all__ and py.typed stubs so mypy picks them up.

maria: test coverage: add a unit test that stubs a 400 text/html body for both sync and async clients and asserts ApiError.status_code, ApiError.raw_body, and ApiError.request_id are set. Mark as regression test.

devx-oncall: +1 to fast-tracking. small patch with a test and typing changes should be OK for a 0.9.3 bugfix. please include changelog entry and migration note.

ana: i'll open the PR with the fix, tests, and a note in docs/migration.md. will include example of safe error handling for users:```py
try:
    await client.generate(...)
except ApiError as ae:
    print(ae.status_code, ae.request_id, ae.raw_body[:200])
```
